card.name: www in FDA web addresses
card.fires_on: The 'www' in an FDA web address (http://www.fda.gov/...), mostly in the line saying information on FDA-approved tests is available at a link. Also once on 'MR' at the start of MRHD.

modes.label: www in FDA link
modes.description: The 'www' right after http:// or 'See' in an FDA companion diagnostics or CYP link.

modes.label: MRHD start
